evidence_scope: Static source inspection only; Gradle, APK, install, foreground service, and overlay evidence are absent.

model.evidence: Current MainActivity loads a remote HTTPS WebView and exposes no local-model adapter.

memory.evidence: Current native source has no connection to the local SQLite memory API.

voice.evidence: Current WebChromeClient denies every WebView permission request.

avatar.evidence: No avatar state engine, asset pack, renderer, or lip-sync code exists on current main.

device.evidence: Current native source has no audited device-bridge integration.

notification.evidence: No foreground service or notification channel exists on current main.

storage.evidence: No native persistence adapter exists on current main.

process.evidence: No root, shell, or Termux process bridge is present in the current native shell.

network.evidence: The activity loads one hard-coded HTTPS chatgpt.site URL and blocks navigation outside that host suffix.

presentation.evidence: A launcher WebView activity exists; overlay, wallpaper, windowed fallback, and degraded-state UI do not.
